children: XCF Global entered into a Warrant Purchase Agreement to raise $1.0 million through a private placement of an Initial Warrant to GL PART SPV II. The warrant covers up to 6,891,798 shares at a $2.50 exercise price, with adjustments for certain corporate actions, and may be exercised for cash or on a cashless basis. The transaction, priced at $0.1451 per underlying share, was a condition to the effectiveness of an amendment to the company’s business combination agreement and closed on September 14, 2026.
: Private placement of common stock purchase warrant
: Raise capital tied to business combination amendment
